name: Mitsubishi Starion
blurb: The Mitsubishi Starion is a sports car which was manufactured and marketed by Mitsubishi from 1982 until 1989 — with badge engineered variants marketed in North America as the Conquest, under the Chrysler, Dodge, and Plymouth brands. It is a two-door coupé with a fastback design and seating for four passengers.
specs: Ryu Kaibuchi, Takashi Kono, Masaki Iwamoto, Hidetoshi Aoki
